verdict.rationale: Docs say Bugbot reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions, and teams can tune reviews with .cursor/BUGBOT.md and org-wide rules. Community reports on noise are mixed: one user says almost none of its comments are frivolous or wrong, while another saw it argue against fixes it had recommended and moved it to request-only mode. Missing for 10: any evidence of severity labels, a documented false-positive rate or precision controls, and independent confirmation that deduplication works in practice.
